verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a mobile SSH/Mosh terminal. Terminals of this kind can plausibly ship AI features that act as MCP clients, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers SSH, Mosh, keys, themes, keyboards and VS Code connectivity, but says nothing about connecting to or using MCP servers or their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
